title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 3,151–3,200 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 新聞業；新聞學；採訪寫作

examples.en: Ethical journalism is the cornerstone of an open and democratic society.
examples.zh: 堅守專業倫理的新聞傳播業是開放自由民主社會不可或缺的基石。

examples.en: She majored in multimedia journalism to learn digital storytelling techniques.
examples.zh: 她主修多媒體新聞學，以學習數位敘事技巧。

examples.en: Investigative journalism plays a critical role in holding powerful institutions accountable.
examples.zh: 調查性新聞在督促權力機構承擔問責方面發揮著關鍵作用。

examples.en: Dedicated journalists risked their lives to report truth from frontline disaster zones.
examples.zh: 敬業無私的新聞記者冒著生命危險深入災區第一線帶回最真實的現場報導。

examples.en: The award-winning journalist uncovered corruption within the city planning office.
examples.zh: 這位屢獲殊榮的記者揭發了市府都發局內部的貪腐弊案。

examples.en: Aspiring journalists must learn to verify sources thoroughly before publishing stories.
examples.zh: 有志從事新聞業的青年在發表報導之前，必須學會徹底查證消息來源。

words.definition: 特派記者；特派通訊員；駐外記者

examples.en: The foreign correspondent reported live from the international summit in Geneva.
examples.zh: 駐外特派記者自日內瓦舉行的全球領袖高峰會現場發回即時連線報導。

examples.en: He worked as a seasoned war correspondent documenting humanitarian crises across the Middle East.
examples.zh: 他曾擔任資深戰地特派記者，記錄中東地區的人道主義危機。

examples.en: The network's financial correspondent analyzed the central bank's unexpected interest rate decision.
examples.zh: 該電視台的財經特派員深入分析了中央銀行出人意料的利率決策。

examples.en: The trade agreement made front-page headlines across major global newspapers.
examples.zh: 該項具里程碑意義的經貿協定強勢榮登全球各大主流報章的頭版頭條新聞。

examples.en: Dramatic environmental crises continue to grab headlines worldwide.
examples.zh: 震撼性的環境危機持續佔據全球各大新聞媒體的頭條版面。

examples.en: Editors spend considerable time crafting an accurate and eye-catching headline.
examples.zh: 編輯們花費大量心思與時間來琢磨既準確又吸睛的新聞標題。

words.definition: 即時快訊；突發重大新聞

examples.en: TV programs were interrupted to broadcast breaking news on the typhoon's landfall.
examples.zh: 各電視頻道隨即插播緊急即時快訊，報導強烈颱風中心正式登陸的最新動態。

examples.en: A breaking news notification flashed across smartphone screens during the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震發生時，智慧型手機螢幕上瞬間跳出突發重大新聞的即時推播通知。

examples.en: The newsroom scrambled to assemble reporters when the breaking news alert sounded.
examples.zh: 當突發即時快訊警報響起時，新聞編輯室人員立即動員記者投入採訪。

examples.en: The health ministry held an emergency press conference regarding epidemic control.
examples.zh: 衛福部緊急召開全台電視直播新聞發布會，向國人說明最新防疫配套措施。

examples.en: Reporters shouted questions simultaneously during the tense post-game press conference.
examples.zh: 賽後氣氛緊繃的新聞發布會上，記者們紛紛爭相大聲提問。

examples.en: The tech CEO announced the brand-new flagship product at a global press conference.
examples.zh: 該科技公司執行長在全球記者會上隆重宣布了這款全新的旗艦產品。

examples.en: The government spokesperson answered media questions regarding the new subsidy policy.
examples.zh: 行政院政府發言人親切詳盡回答媒體記者有關各項民生最新補貼政策提問。

examples.en: A company spokesperson clarified that no customer credit card data was compromised.
examples.zh: 公司發言人主動出面澄清，客戶的信用卡資料並未遭到任何洩漏。

examples.en: Being an effective spokesperson requires poise under pressure and clear articulation.
examples.zh: 成為一名優秀的發言人需要在高壓環境下保持沉著鎮定並具備清晰的表達能力。

words.definition: 獨家的；專屬的；獨家新聞

examples.en: The magazine published an exclusive interview with the Olympic gold medalist.
examples.zh: 該深度專題雜誌刊登了針對台灣奧運金牌得主的獨家專訪完整全紀錄。

examples.en: Club members enjoy exclusive access to private lounges and VIP facilities.
examples.zh: 該俱樂部的會員享有使用私人貴賓室與 VIP 專屬設施的特權。

examples.en: The news channel broke a major exclusive about the impending corporate merger.
examples.zh: 該新聞頻道播報了一則關於兩家巨頭即將合併的重磅獨家內幕。

examples.en: The reporter protected the identity of the anonymous inside whistleblower source.
examples.zh: 這位正直的記者全力保護提供貪腐內幕的匿名內部吹哨者之真實身分。

examples.en: Police solved the burglary case thanks to an anonymous tip from a neighbor.
examples.zh: 多虧鄰居提供的一則匿名線報，警方順利偵破了這起入室竊盜案。

examples.en: Online surveys often collect anonymous feedback to encourage honest responses.
examples.zh: 線上問卷調查通常採匿名填寫方式，以鼓勵受訪者提供最真實的回饋。

words.definition: 不公開發表的；私下聊天的；不列入紀錄

examples.en: The diplomat spoke off the record to provide background context for the treaty.
examples.zh: 這位資深外交官以不公開發表的私下背景說明方式為記者梳理條約脈絡。

examples.en: The politician reminded reporters that her candid comments were strictly off the record.
examples.zh: 該政治人物提醒在場記者，她方才的坦率談話嚴格屬於不列入紀錄的私下交流。

examples.en: Journalists must respect off-the-record agreements to maintain trust with confidential sources.
examples.zh: 新聞工作者必須尊重不公開發表的默契，以維繫與保密消息來源之間的信任。

examples.en: The newspaper's editorial called for urgent investments in renewable energy.
examples.zh: 該報今日刊登的重量級社論強烈呼籲各界應擴大推動綠色再生能源投資。

examples.en: She joined the publishing house as an editorial assistant proofreading manuscripts.
examples.zh: 她加入出版社擔任編輯助理，負責校對書稿。

examples.en: The paper's editorial board unanimously endorsed the new educational reform bill.
examples.zh: 該報的社論委員會全票表決贊成並支持這項教育改革新法案。

examples.en: The renowned columnist writes weekly analyses on macroeconomic market trends.
examples.zh: 這位享譽盛名的財經專欄作家每週撰寫專欄深入剖析全球總體經濟脈動。

examples.en: Readers eagerly await the humorous life stories penned by the lifestyle columnist.
examples.zh: 廣大讀者每週都熱切期盼著那位生活專欄作家筆下風趣幽默的生活雜感。

examples.en: A syndicated columnist has their articles distributed to hundreds of newspapers.
examples.zh: 聯合報業專欄作家的文章會被分發授權給全美數百家報紙刊登。

examples.en: The tech company issued a formal press release announcing its latest smartphone.
examples.zh: 該跨國科技巨擘正式發布官方新聞稿，隆重宣布旗下新一代旗艦智慧手機。

examples.en: PR agencies distribute press releases to journalists to generate media buzz.
examples.zh: 公關公司將新聞稿廣泛分發給各大媒體記者，以掀起話題與報導熱潮。

examples.en: The joint press release clarified details regarding the strategic business alliance.
examples.zh: 雙方聯合發布的新聞稿詳細說明了策略商業聯盟的各項合作細節。

words.definition: 新聞報導；媒體曝光；保險理賠範圍

examples.en: The presidential election received comprehensive 24/7 media coverage nationwide.
examples.zh: 總統大選在全台各大電視新聞台與網路媒體獲得了二十四小時全方位即時報導。

examples.en: Ensure your travel insurance policy provides adequate medical coverage abroad.
examples.zh: 出國前請確保你的旅遊平安險保單包含足夠的海外醫療理賠保障。

examples.en: Live television coverage brought the historic space mission directly into living rooms.
examples.zh: 電視現場直播報導將這項具歷史意義的太空探測任務直接呈現在大眾客廳中。

words.definition: 聳動的；煽情的；引起轟動的

examples.en: Avoid reading sensational tabloid rumors that lack verified empirical evidence.
examples.zh: 盡量避免閱讀那些充斥著誇大聳動字眼、缺乏客觀事實查證的八卦小報謠言。

examples.en: The young prodigy gave a sensational violin performance that received a standing ovation.
examples.zh: 這位音樂神童帶來了一場驚艷全場的精彩小提琴演奏，贏得了全體起立鼓掌。

examples.en: Media critics accused the outlet of sensational reporting to boost ratings.
examples.zh: 媒體評論家指責該電視台為了拉抬收視率而採取誇大煽情的新聞報導手法。

words.definition: 標題黨；騙點閱誘餌標題

examples.en: Don't be fooled by exaggerated clickbait headlines on social media feeds.
examples.zh: 千萬不要被社群動態牆上那些語不驚人死不休的誇大標題黨誘餌所矇騙。

examples.en: The article turned out to be pure clickbait with no actual substance behind the shocking title.
examples.zh: 這篇文章被證實純粹是騙點閱的標題黨，驚悚標題底下根本毫無實質內容。

examples.en: Online publishers increasingly rely on deceptive clickbait to drive traffic to ad-filled pages.
examples.zh: 網路出版商越來越依賴欺騙性的誘餌標題，將流量導入充斥廣告的網頁。

words.definition: 不實資訊；誤傳訊息（非惡意）

examples.en: Misinformation about health remedies spread quickly among messaging family groups.
examples.zh: 許多未經醫學證實的健康偏方不實資訊在家族通訊群組中快速轉發流傳。

examples.en: Social media algorithms should label misinformation to prevent public confusion.
examples.zh: 社群媒體演算法應對不實訊息進行標籤警示，以防止公眾陷入混亂困惑。

examples.en: Fact-checking groups work tirelessly to combat health-related misinformation online.
examples.zh: 事實查核團體不辭辛勞地致力於遏止網路上流傳的各類健康不實資訊。

words.definition: 惡意假訊息；虛假認知作戰宣傳

examples.en: Hostile state actors deploy coordinated disinformation campaigns to sow societal discord.
examples.zh: 境外敵對勢力透過發動有組織的惡意假訊息認知作戰企圖分化社會凝聚力。

examples.en: Disinformation is intentionally fabricated to deceive the public and influence elections.
examples.zh: 惡意假訊息是刻意捏造出來的，旨在誤導社會大眾並操弄選舉結果。

examples.en: Intelligence agencies warned of coordinated bot networks spreading political disinformation.
examples.zh: 情報機關發出警告，指出有協同運作的殭屍網路正在散播政治惡意假訊息。

words.definition: 騙局；網路謠言；惡作劇惡搞

examples.en: The viral tsunami warning video proved to be an AI-generated internet hoax.
examples.zh: 那支在網路上被瘋傳的海嘯末日警報影片事後被證實是一場 AI 惡意造假騙局。

examples.en: The alien sighting turned out to be an elaborate hoax organized by local pranksters.
examples.zh: 所謂的外星人目擊事件最終被證實是當地惡作劇者精心策劃的一場騙局。

examples.en: Police warned that reporting bomb hoaxes carries severe prison sentences.
examples.zh: 警方嚴正警告，惡意通報虛假炸彈恐嚇惡作劇將面臨嚴重的刑事判刑。

examples.en: Professional fact-checkers worked swiftly to debunk false viral political claims.
examples.zh: 專業的事實查核中心研究員迅速採取行動，逐一闢謠並拆穿網路虛假謠言。

examples.en: The documentary aims to debunk common historical myths with archaeological evidence.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片旨在以確鑿的考古證據來揭穿並打破流傳已久的歷史迷思。

examples.en: Scientists published comprehensive studies to debunk false claims about vaccine dangers.
examples.zh: 科學家發表了詳盡的研究報告，以徹底駁斥並拆穿有關疫苗危害的不實謠言。

words.definition: 事實查核；真相查核作業

examples.en: The Taiwan FactCheck Center conducts rigorous fact-checking on viral content.
examples.zh: 台灣事實查核中心秉持嚴謹的查核標準，對網路上熱門的可疑傳聞進行事實查核。

examples.en: Real-time fact-checking during presidential debates helps voters evaluate candidates' claims.
examples.zh: 在總統電視辯論期間進行即時事實查核，能幫助選民客觀評估候選人的說法。

examples.en: News organizations have expanded their dedicated fact-checking teams prior to elections.
examples.zh: 各大新聞機構在選舉前紛紛擴編了專門的事實查核團隊。

examples.en: Responsible citizens always verify news facts across multiple reputable sources.
examples.zh: 具備高度素養的閱聽人總是會主動透過多家權威公正的管道交叉查證新聞真相。

examples.en: Banks require customers to verify their identity with a security code sent via SMS.
examples.zh: 銀行要求客戶使用透過簡訊發送的安全驗證碼來驗證其真實身分。

examples.en: The lab repeated the experiment to verify the accuracy of the initial measurements.
examples.zh: 實驗室重複進行了實驗，以驗證最初測量數據的精準度。

examples.en: Spreading unverified rumors destroys an investigative journalist's professional credibility.
examples.zh: 隨意散布未經求證的傳聞將會徹底摧毀一位深度調查記者長年累積的專業公信力。

examples.en: Citing peer-reviewed studies significantly enhances the credibility of your research paper.
examples.zh: 引用經同儕審查的學術研究能大幅提升你的學術論文可信度。

examples.en: Once lost, an institution's credibility with the public is extremely hard to rebuild.
examples.zh: 一個機構在大眾心中的公信力一旦喪失，便極難再次重建。

words.definition: 媒體素養；媒體識讀能力

examples.en: School curricula teach media literacy to help students distinguish facts from opinions.
examples.zh: 學校 108 課綱積極推動媒體素養教育，培養學生辨析客觀事實與主觀觀點之能力。

examples.en: Media literacy empowers citizens to critically evaluate online algorithms and sponsored posts.
examples.zh: 媒體識讀能力使公民有能力批判性地審視網路演算法與業配贊助內容。

examples.en: Workshops promoting media literacy are especially beneficial for elderly internet users.
examples.zh: 推廣媒體素養的研習工作坊對年長的上網族群尤其大有裨益。

examples.en: Taiwan consistently ranks number one in Asia for independent press freedom.
examples.zh: 台灣在無國界記者組織的全球評比中，新聞自由度長年穩居亞洲第一寶座。

examples.en: Press freedom is fundamental to uncovering corruption and ensuring democratic governance.
examples.zh: 新聞自由是揭發政府弊端與確保民主良善治理的根本基石。

examples.en: Authoritarian regimes systematically suppress press freedom by arresting critical journalists.
examples.zh: 威權體制經常透過拘捕異議記者來系統性地打壓與剝奪新聞自由。

words.definition: 新聞審查；言論審查制度

examples.en: Totalitarian regimes enforce strict internet censorship to block external news.
examples.zh: 極權專制政權常透過嚴苛的網路長城言論審查制度來全面阻絕境外獨立新聞。

examples.en: The film underwent severe censorship before being approved for release overseas.
examples.zh: 這部電影在獲准在海外上映之前經歷了嚴格的內容審查。

examples.en: Online platforms face difficult debates over content moderation versus digital censorship.
examples.zh: 網路平台在社群內容管理規範與數位言論審查之間面臨著艱難的兩難抉擇。

examples.en: Legal protection protects brave corporate whistleblowers from employer retaliation.
examples.zh: 完善健全的揭弊者保護法能保障勇敢揭發不法的內部吹哨者免遭雇主惡意報復。

examples.en: The whistleblower leaked confidential emails revealing that the car maker faked emissions tests.
examples.zh: 吹哨者洩漏了內部機密郵件，揭露這家汽車製造商偽造排氣檢驗數據。

examples.en: Hotlines allow workers to become an internal whistleblower safely and anonymously.
examples.zh: 檢舉專線讓在職員工能夠在安全且匿名的機制下成為內部揭弊吹哨者。

examples.en: The celebrity sued the tabloid for million-dollar damages over malicious defamation.
examples.zh: 該知名藝人針對八卦小報刊登不實惡意指控正式提告求償千萬名譽毀損賠償。

examples.en: Defamation can be classified as slander if spoken, or libel if published in writing.
examples.zh: 誹謗行為若為口頭形式稱為口頭誹謗，若以文字發表則歸類為文字誹謗。

examples.en: The court found the blogger guilty of criminal defamation and ordered a hefty fine.
examples.zh: 法院判定該部落客犯有刑事誹謗罪，並處以高額罰金。

words.definition: 撤回報導；更正啟事聲明

examples.en: The newspaper issued a front-page retraction and sincere public apology.
examples.zh: 該報在查明失誤後火速於頭版刊登了撤回更正啟事並向受害當事人誠摯致歉。

examples.en: The journal demanded a retraction after discovering fabricated data in the paper.
examples.zh: 學術期刊在發現論文中包含偽造數據後，勒令作者撤回該篇論文。

examples.en: Publishing an immediate retraction minimizes the legal liability stemming from reporting errors.
examples.zh: 立即刊登更正啟事撤回報導能將採訪錯誤帶來的法律責任降至最低。

examples.en: Readers should recognize political bias when consuming partisan news commentary.
examples.zh: 閱聽大眾在收看立場鮮明的政論節目時，應具備辨識黨派政治偏頗立場的能力。

examples.en: Confirmation bias leads individuals to only accept information that supports their views.
examples.zh: 確認偏誤會讓人們只願意接受那些印證自身既有觀點的資訊。

examples.en: The judge stepped down to avoid any perception of racial or personal bias.
examples.zh: 該法官主動迴避審判，以避免引發任何種族或個人偏見的質疑。

examples.en: Professional reporting requires strict adherence to factual truth and objectivity.
examples.zh: 專業的新聞採訪寫作必須恪守忠於客觀事實真相與不偏不倚的崇高客觀性。

examples.en: Scientific research demands rigorous objectivity during data collection and analysis.
examples.zh: 科學研究在數據蒐集與分析過程中要求極為嚴謹的客觀公正性。

examples.en: Maintaining journalistic objectivity can be challenging when reporting on emotionally charged tragedies.
examples.zh: 在報導令人心碎的情感悲劇時，維護新聞報導的客觀性往往極具挑戰。

examples.en: Film reviews are inherently subjective expressions of individual artistic taste.
examples.zh: 影評心得本質上屬於個人藝術鑑賞品味與審美偏好的主觀抒發與表達。

examples.en: Pain is subjective, meaning each patient experiences and describes it differently.
examples.zh: 疼痛感是高度主觀的，意味著每位患者所感受與描述的痛感都互不相同。

examples.en: Performance evaluations should focus on measurable achievements rather than subjective opinions.
examples.zh: 員工績效考核應著眼於可衡量的量化成果，而非主管個人的主觀印象。

examples.en: The veteran prime-time news anchor delivered the election special calmly.
examples.zh: 資深黃金時段當家新聞主播沉著穩健、專業流暢地主持了長達數小時的開票特報。

examples.en: Becoming a successful news anchor requires clear diction, charisma, and composure.
examples.zh: 成為一名成功的新聞主播需要吐字清晰、具備鏡頭魅力並在突發狀況下沉著自若。

examples.en: The news anchor signed off with her signature farewell phrase every evening.
examples.zh: 這位新聞主播每天傍晚結束播報時都會說出她標誌性的道別語。

examples.en: Millions tuned in to the national holiday fireworks live broadcast.
examples.zh: 數百萬海內外觀眾透過電視與網路同步鎖定國慶璀璨煙火秀的現場實況轉播。

examples.en: An unexpected glitch interrupted the live broadcast during the award ceremony.
examples.zh: 一場突如其來的技術故障中斷了頒獎典禮進行中的現場直播。

examples.en: The football championship final will be transmitted as a global live broadcast.
examples.zh: 足球錦標賽決賽將透過全球衛星訊號進行跨國現場實況轉播。

examples.en: Studio news anchors read scripts smoothly scrolling on the teleprompter screen.
examples.zh: 攝影棚內的新聞主播看著讀稿機螢幕上流暢滾動的講稿進行專業播報。

examples.en: The president glanced naturally between the audience and the transparent teleprompter.
examples.zh: 總統在演講時自然地在台下聽眾與透明讀稿機之間來回切換視線。

examples.en: When the teleprompter froze, the presenter skillfully improvised without missing a beat.
examples.zh: 當讀稿機螢幕卡住當機時，主持人臨危不亂地即興發揮，毫無破綻。

examples.en: The Central News Agency (CNA) delivers real-time updates to media outlets globally.
examples.zh: 台灣中央通訊社（CNA）即時向全球各大媒體機構提供第一手權威新聞電訊。

examples.en: Major news agencies like Reuters and AP station correspondents in every global capital.
examples.zh: 像路透社與美聯社這樣的大型國際通訊社在世界各國首都均派駐了特派通訊員。

examples.en: Local newspapers subscribe to wires from a national news agency to cover world events.
examples.zh: 地方報社訂閱國家通訊社的新聞電訊，以刊載報導國際時事新聞。

words.definition: 報紙發行量；血液循環；流通

examples.en: Print newspaper circulation declined as readers shifted to digital news apps.
examples.zh: 隨著廣大讀者群全面轉向手機數位新聞 App，傳統紙本實體報紙的發行量逐年下降。

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise improves blood circulation throughout the entire body.
examples.zh: 定期進行有氧運動有助於改善並促進全身的血液循環。

examples.en: The commemorative gold coins were issued for public circulation by the central bank.
examples.zh: 中央銀行發行了紀念金幣供社會大眾公開流通收藏。

words.definition: 狗仔隊；專門偷拍名人的攝影記者

examples.en: Aggressive paparazzi chased the movie star's car through narrow downtown alleys.
examples.zh: 緊追不捨的狗仔隊攝影車在市區狹窄巷弄中瘋狂追逐知名影星的座車。

examples.en: Celebrities often wear sunglasses and hats to avoid being recognized by lurking paparazzi.
examples.zh: 明星名流外出時常佩戴墨鏡與帽子，以防被潛伏在旁的狗仔隊認出偷拍。

examples.en: A swarm of paparazzi camped outside the luxury hotel waiting for the arrival of the pop star.
examples.zh: 一大群狗仔隊通宵守候在豪華飯店外，等待流行巨星的抵達。

examples.en: Drone surveillance near residential windows is an unlawful invasion of privacy.
examples.zh: 在住宅私人窗戶旁進行無人機偷拍窺探屬於違法的嚴重侵犯個人隱私權行徑。

examples.en: Please draw the curtains to give our family complete privacy during dinner.
examples.zh: 請拉上窗簾，讓我們一家人在用餐時享有充分的私人隱私空間。

examples.en: Tech platforms face mounting scrutiny over how they handle user data privacy.
examples.zh: 科技平台在如何處理使用者數據隱私方面正面臨日益嚴厲的檢視。

examples.en: Exposing food safety violations clearly serves the vital public interest.
examples.zh: 勇敢揭發黑心黑心廠商黑心食品食安違法弊端，完全符合且捍衛了全體公眾利益。

examples.en: The court decided that disclosing the environmental audit was in the public interest.
examples.zh: 法院判定公開環境稽核報告完全符合社會大眾的公共利益。

examples.en: Good governance always places the public interest above private corporate profits.
examples.zh: 良善的治理之道始終堅持將全民公共利益置於個別企業的私利之上。

words.definition: 倫理道德；專業職業道德

examples.en: Journalists must uphold high professional ethics by refusing bribery and bribes.
examples.zh: 新聞從業人員必須恪守崇高的專業新聞倫理道德，嚴正拒絕任何形式的紅包賄賂。

examples.en: The medical school offers mandatory courses exploring bioethics and patient rights.
examples.zh: 醫學院開設了探討生命倫理與病患權益的必修專業課程。

examples.en: Business leaders who ignore business ethics risk destroying consumer confidence overnight.
examples.zh: 漠視商業道德的企業領袖可能會在一夜之間徹底摧毀消費者的信任。

words.definition: 深偽技術；AI 偽造影音換臉

examples.en: Detectors use AI algorithms to spot deepfake videos manipulating political speeches.
examples.zh: 專家利用先進 AI 辨識演算法來精準抓出那些遭到惡意深偽換臉的政客演講假影片。

examples.en: Criminals generated a deepfake voice of a CEO to trick the accountant into wiring funds.
examples.zh: 詐騙份子利用 AI 深度偽造生成執行長的語音，誘騙會計人員跨國電匯款項。

examples.en: Lawmakers are drafting legislation to penalize malicious non-consensual deepfake pornography.
examples.zh: 立法機關正積極研擬法案，以重罰未經同意惡意散布的深偽換臉成人影音。

words.definition: 演算法的；由演算法驅動的

examples.en: Algorithmic curation feeds users posts that match their pre-existing viewpoints.
examples.zh: 演算法內容推薦機制會不斷向用戶推送完全契合其既有立場的同質性貼文。

examples.en: High-frequency trading firms rely on algorithmic models to execute thousands of trades per second.
examples.zh: 高頻交易公司仰賴複雜的演算法模型，每秒鐘能自動執行數千筆金融交易。

examples.en: Researchers study algorithmic bias to prevent discriminatory outcomes in loan approvals.
examples.zh: 研究人員深入研究演算法偏見，以防止貸款審批系統產生歧視性的決策偏差。

words.definition: 同溫層效應；回音室效應

examples.en: Social media algorithms can trap users inside a narrow ideological echo chamber.
examples.zh: 社群平台的演算法推薦機制容易將用戶禁錮在封閉且單一的意識形態同溫層回音室中。

examples.en: Surrounding yourself only with people who agree with you creates a stifling intellectual echo chamber.
examples.zh: 若身邊只充斥著附和贊同自己的人，會營造出扼殺思想激盪的窒息式同溫層。

examples.en: To escape the echo chamber effect, one must deliberately seek out diverse perspectives.
examples.zh: 若想要擺脫同溫層效應，就必須主動刻意去接觸不同立場的多元觀點。

examples.en: Breaking out of your filter bubble requires actively reading opposing perspectives.
examples.zh: 想要跳出量身定制的資訊濾泡，需要主動且寬容地閱讀不同立場的反方深度觀點。

examples.en: Personalized search results keep users inside an invisible personalized filter bubble.
examples.zh: 個人化的搜尋結果會讓使用者被困在隱形且量身打造的資訊過濾氣泡中。

examples.en: He realized his worldview was skewed because his social feed formed a tight filter bubble.
examples.zh: 他意識到自己的世界觀出現了偏差，因為社群動態牆形成了一個緊密的過濾氣泡。

words.definition: 社會對立極化；政治兩極分化

examples.en: Sensational political debates risk deepening societal polarization and mistrust.
examples.zh: 過度煽情且缺乏理性的政論口水戰恐將進一步加深社會群體間的對立與互不信任。

examples.en: Scholars analyze how social networks contribute to rising political polarization worldwide.
examples.zh: 學者們深入剖析社群網路如何助長全球範圍內日益嚴重的政治兩極對立分化。

examples.en: Open civil dialogue across party lines is essential to bridge political polarization.
examples.zh: 跨越黨派立場的開誠布公公民對話，是彌合政治兩極對立所不可或缺的良方。

examples.en: Public opinion shifted strongly in favor of environmental conservation policies.
examples.zh: 全民社會輿論風向全面轉向強烈支持並落實各項生態環境永續保育政策。

examples.en: Investigative documentaries have the power to shape public opinion on critical social issues.
examples.zh: 深度調查紀錄片擁有強大力量，足以引導並形塑社會大眾對重大議題的輿論認知。

examples.en: Politicians often monitor public opinion closely before announcing controversial decisions.
examples.zh: 政治人物在宣布爭議性重大決策之前，通常會極為密切地觀察民間輿論風向。

words.definition: 民意調查；投票；進行民調

examples.en: Independent opinion polls reflected high citizen satisfaction with public transit.
examples.zh: 獨立客觀的民調機構調查數據顯示，廣大市民對大眾捷運與公車服務滿意度極高。

examples.en: Over eighty percent of polled consumers preferred environmentally friendly packaging.
examples.zh: 超過八成受訪受測的消費者表示更青睞使用對環境友善的綠色環保包裝。

examples.en: The research team will poll a thousand registered voters before the upcoming referendum.
examples.zh: 研究團隊將在即將登場的公民投票前，對一千名合格選民進行民意調查。

words.definition: 公民參與；公民社會投入

examples.en: Youth participating in community town halls exemplifies active civic engagement.
examples.zh: 青年學子積極出席社區公共事務公民論壇，充分展現了主動活躍的公民參與精神。

examples.en: Voting in local elections is the most direct form of democratic civic engagement.
examples.zh: 在地方公職人員選舉中投下神聖一票，是民主社會中最直接的一種公民參與形式。

examples.en: Non-profit organizations foster civic engagement by running neighbourhood improvement workshops.
examples.zh: 非營利組織透過舉辦社區改造工作坊，積極推動在地居民的公共事務公民參與。

examples.en: Digital literacy education provides powerful empowerment for disadvantaged communities.
examples.zh: 普及數位識讀與科技素養教育為弱勢偏鄉社區族群提供了翻轉未來的強大培力。

examples.en: Microfinance programs offer economic empowerment to women in developing countries.
examples.zh: 微型貸款扶助計畫為發展中國家的女性群體提供了自主自立的經濟培力與賦權。

examples.en: True leadership is about empowerment, helping team members unlock their highest potential.
examples.zh: 真正卓絕的領導力在於充分賦權與信任，協助團隊成員激發出其內在的最大潛能。
